'''Mirfa Independent Water and Power Project''' (محطة المرفأ للمنتج المستقل٫ محطة المرفأ الجديدة, محطة ميبكو) is an operating power station of at least 1697-megawatts (MW) in Al Mirfa, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
It is also known as New Al Mirfa Power Plant, MIPCO, New Mifrah.

CHP is an abbreviation for Combined Heat and Power. It is a technology that produces electricity and thermal energy at high efficiencies. Coal units track this information in the Captive Use section when known.
